message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes from facts. Facts: defendant Wang2 gave bribe of 20,000 RMB to health bureau director Wang3 to seek job adjustment, resulting in being appointed as director of another health center. This is bribery (giving bribe). The crime is "行贿". Since it's a public official (health bureau director) receiving bribe, the giver is committing "行贿罪". No, because only defendant is Wang2. So output single crime.
